# Case Study & Proof

`case-study-and-proof` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Content & Copy
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/case-study-and-proof/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Would this customer result convince a sceptical buyer, and what are we actually allowed to publish?

**Inputs:** The customer and what changed, the before and after numbers with the metric and period, what else was changing at the time, any quote with a name and role, and what permission exists in writing

**Output:** A credibility score with the missing pieces ranked, a testimonial-versus-case-study call, a permission verdict naming what may be published, and the anonymised version when it may not

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill case-study-and-proof`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/case-study-and-proof/resources/proof-check.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/case-study-and-proof/resources/proof-check.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It scores whether each of eight pieces is present, not whether it is true. A before number reconstructed from memory scores the same as one that was measured.
- The permission check compares what you list as covered with what you list as used. It can't read the agreement or tell whether the approver could grant it.
- A descriptor such as sector, size and region counts as an identifiable customer, so an anonymised study can score full marks on that factor.
- The 100-point weights are AAJ's view of what a sceptic checks, not a measure of how buyers respond to the page.

**Review before acting:** The account owner confirms the before number was measured and the list of other changes is complete. Legal or the account owner checks the written permission covers every use (name, logo, numbers, quote) before anything is published.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/case-study-and-proof](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/case-study-and-proof)
